instructions.windows: Run the Windows x64 installer, then launch Certifyd Core from the Start Menu or desktop.
instructions.macos: Choose the DMG for Apple Silicon or Intel, open it, drag Certifyd Core.app to Applications, then open the app.
instructions.linuxDeb: On a Debian-compatible desktop, open the matching .deb with the graphical package installer, then launch Certifyd Core from the application menu.
instructions.linuxPortable: For an advanced portable install, extract the matching .tar.gz and run ./start.sh from the extracted folder.
instructions.owner: On the local sign-in screen, choose New here?, complete Create owner, and keep any recovery material private.
instructions.dashboard: Open http://127.0.0.1:4000 on the computer running Core if the dashboard does not open automatically.
